text: Objective This objective is to train students to be technical personnel working, after graduation, in the fields of the development, design and maintenance of computer application software and network software.. Core courses Higher Mathematics, Digital Circuit, Software Engineering Foundation, Discrete Mathematics, Data Structure, Network Principle, Operation System, C Language Program Design, Database Principle, Soft Engineering, Software Testing and Maintenance, Face The Target And Design Program, Object-Oriented Programming, Object-Oriented Analysis and Design, Project Management, Java Program Design, Algorithm Designing and Analysis, Windows Program Design, Design of Assemble Program and Linux Program Design. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Engineering or Science is granted.
